**Hejmdal Privathospital Viby, beh.afsnit** is a treatment department within a Danish private hospital. It is highlighted in the national ADHD database quality reports as a prime example of the systematic challenges and near-total lack of implementation of specific clinical quality standards among private healthcare providers in Denmark [^src1]. 

During the 2024/25 reporting period, the department recorded a 0% performance rate for both [[indikator-2a|Indikator 2a]] and [[indikator-2b|Indikator 2b]] [^src1]. These indicators are critical components of the national monitoring infrastructure for ADHD diagnostics. Indikator 2a measures whether a clinical environmental observation is conducted for children aged 0–5, while Indikator 2b tracks the use of structured interviews or environmental observations for children and adolescents aged 6–17 [^src1]. The department's complete failure to meet these metrics underscores a broader narrative within the database, which documents that private hospitals largely failed to perform the required clinical environmental observations, standing in stark contrast to several public clinics that consistently met or approached the ≥90% development targets [^src1].
